newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads four for rape and theft.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads four for rape and theft.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded four men on Monday for raping a woman and stealing money from her home, the government announced.

An interior ministry statement read on Saudi television said the three Saudi nationals and a Pakistani stormed into the home of a foreigner while under the influence of alcohol, raped his wife and stole money.
The executions by the sword in the holy city of Mecca in western Saudi Arabia brought the number of people executed in the conservative kingdom this year to 42.
Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and traffickers, rapists and other criminals. Alcohol is strictly forbidden in the kingdom.
